draft.text: You came to see the doctor because your cholesterol levels were high, found during a finger prick test at your annual checkup.
You eat a healthy diet most days and ride your bike on trails regularly.
You don't have any symptoms like chest pain, shortness of breath, or fatigue.
Your cholesterol is high, but we don't know the exact numbers.
Your grandparents say they didn't have high cholesterol or heart problems when they were young.
They also mentioned a cousin who had a heart attack at around 44-45 years old.
We will discuss next steps to understand more about your cholesterol and what to do next.
